title: Tencent acquires 25% stake in FromSoftware parent Kadokawa
content: Tencent has acquired a 25% stake in Kadokawa Corporation, the Japanese media conglomerate that owns FromSoftware, the studio behind Elden Ring and Dark Souls. The deal, valued at approximately $1.5 billion, gives Tencent a significant foothold in Japan's premium AAA development ecosystem. Kadokawa's other subsidiaries include game publisher Spike Chunsoft and anime studio Doga Kobo. Analysts note this move deepens Tencent's strategy of acquiring minority stakes in high-prestige global studios rather than outright acquisitions, following similar investments in Epic Games, Remedy Entertainment, and Marvelous.
